title: decision: mimid leaves advertise every component mimid implements
description: mls-extensions #110 rules 3 and 6 force every member's leaf to list each component the GroupContext holds state for (hub rooms: 0x0021, 0x0022, 0x0025, 0x0027). Mark 2026-11-02: a fixed list, not a per-identity setting: 0x0004 last_resort_key_package, 0x0020 frank_aad, 0x0021 franking_agent, 0x0022 participant_list, 0x0023 room_metadata, 0x0024-0x0029 room-policy components, plus one GREASE value; never 0x0001/0x0002 (K1). Implemented in K5.
